resources.string: Wi-Fi will be re-enabled automatically after reboot.
Wi-Fi will be enabled automatically after reboot (Android 8–9) or a notification will prompt you (Android 10+).
On Android 10+, tap the notification after reboot to open Wi-Fi settings and enable it manually.
Tap the notification to open Wi-Fi settings.
Notifies you to enable Wi-Fi after boot on Android 10+
Tap to open Wi-Fi settings and turn on Wi-Fi.
